# Original Expr loose-variable pair

Four original raw/owned boxed rows for `hasLooseBVar` and `lowerLooseBVars`, pinned to Lean 4.33.1 commit `819816b2e0a3bf405af45ae5c7af2491d8f5bee6` and accepted index `74d833d577923821b982e8a9e872a38b5cad011513eb18870b51417e13397f0e`. Only optional top-level pretty is omitted; each record retains its exact full-CAS SHA. Original source is Apache 2.0 licensed, copyright Microsoft Corporation, author Leonardo de Moura (LICENSE).

The two-native plus nine-constructor static closure has 55 rows and no initialized globals; the larger 75-row source research envelope also includes the separate quickLt proposal and comparison-hook evidence. This pair enables no quickLt, image admission or source authority.

The safe Oracle.lean uses original source constructors and the two pinned natives. It excludes assertion-violating narrowed lower inputs. Expected output is not a substitute for a native observation; receipts distinguish parent-run native `--run` from JVM gates and author-side bounded compilation. Small BigInteger ingress, forged cache/storage, private work injection and Host prefixes are explicit JVM models, not native source-allocation or memory-safety claims.
